Subject: OrbitHealth discovery — follow-up & time-baton for deep dive

Hi Lina —

Great to meet you and Tom on today's call. Quick recap from our side: OrbitHealth is evaluating a low-latency inference path for clinician-facing summaries, and you flagged throughput for batch ingest and strict data residency for EU patients. We confirmed that Redwood can support private VPC deployments and reserved capacity for predictable throughput.

Next steps I suggested on the call:
- Schedule an engineering deep dive (45–60m) with Tom and your infra lead to walk through the private endpoint and latency profile testing.
- Share a proposed agenda and a set of time windows that work across US/EU/APAC.

Because you have stakeholders across time zones, I put together a rotating time-baton approach so no one team is always stuck with late calls. Proposed rotation (high level):
- Week A: US morning (PDT) / EU afternoon (CEST) / APAC evening (AEST)
- Week B: EU morning / APAC afternoon / US late afternoon
- Week C: APAC morning / US evening / EU late afternoon

I attached a simple matrix with candidate times — if you can indicate availability on 2–3 options we’ll lock the first deep-dive and seed the rotation. Also included a draft agenda.

Calendly link for quick booking: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/deep-dive-45m

Thanks — I’ll loop in Karthik (solutions) and Tessa (customer success) to coordinate the timeline.

Best,
Monica

Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
